name: Omarchy Help
author: modpunk
description: Help for Omarchy that answers and acts, on your own GPU. • Search your live keybindings, omarchy CLI and manual as you type • Run a command safely in one click • Open the manual at the right heading • Chat with a local model about Omarchy or anything else • Build it: turn a missing feature into a plugin or an omarchy.fans cloud web app with Rix or your coding agent

barWidget.description: Bar button that opens Omarchy Help: search keybindings, commands and the manual; run, open, or chat.
